Changes: Imported only 88 constellation line topologies, joined 710 HIP endpoints to the pinned HYG v4.1 catalogue and retained 9 faint supporting stars. No illustrations are included. Original upstream description/source and exact hashes are retained in vendor/stellarium-modern and figure-manifest.json. The derived figure database remains CC BY-SA 4.0; the application licence does not replace the data licence.

Star coordinates: David Nash / Astronexus HYG Database v4.1, CC BY-SA 4.0. Original HYG attribution and source hashes remain in sky-data-manifest.json.
